# Varun Choraria

> B2B SaaS product marketer, now at HCL Tech. Essays on go-to-market strategy, management, careers, AI, product marketing, and building useful things.

## About

Varun Choraria is a B2B SaaS product marketer with 8+ years of experience across Vymo, Freshworks and GTM Buddy. Since September 2026 he is Group Manager, Product Marketing at HCL Tech. He led marketing at GTM Buddy (Series A) from January to August 2026, was Lead, Product Marketing (PLG) at Freshworks (2024-2026), and was a founding product marketer at Vymo (2019-2024). Views on the site are his own and do not represent his employer.

## Side Projects

- [/side-quests/](/side-quests/): projects, tools, and experiments, each labelled Public or Private
- Open source, free to use:
  - **interview-recon** (https://github.com/vcxcvii/interview-recon): turns an AI coding agent into an interview research analyst
  - **master-shifu** (https://github.com/vcxcvii/master-shifu): 32 consulting frameworks from 19 MBA casebooks as agent commands
  - **michealangelo** (https://github.com/vcxcvii/michealangelo): self-improving design-system skills for AI coding agents
- Private, documented publicly:
  - [/side-quests/lazarus-pit/](/side-quests/lazarus-pit/): **lazarus-pit**, a self-healing UX agent that reads Microsoft Clarity data and files fix proposals as GitHub issues on this site

## Beyond Work

- [/speaking/](/speaking/): book, speaking, and podcast work
  - **Book:** *Miracle-preneuring: Why anyone can and should be an entrepreneur* (2016), self-published, covered by Forbes, Entrepreneur, and 50+ outlets. Available on Amazon and Apple Books.
  - **Speaking:** talks on product marketing and B2B GTM at Wynter, Product Marketing Alliance, AIC Prestige / AIM / Niti Aayog / Microsoft For Startups, and others.
  - **Podcast:** co-hosted *The Edge Podcast for CHROs* (2021, two seasons) on the future of work, with guests from Oracle, Infosys, Razorpay, MetLife, Ather Energy, GoJek, Zoho, and Doist.
